# shadow/effect-cleanup-registered

Require event listeners, intervals and subscriptions made in an effect to be cleaned up.

`recommended` `has suggestions`

## Why

An effect re-runs when its sources change and is disposed with its owner. Anything it starts (`addEventListener`, `setInterval`, `.subscribe()`, observers, sockets) keeps running unless a cleanup stops it, so listeners pile up on every re-run and leak after the component is gone. Register `onCleanup(...)` or return a cleanup function.

## Incorrect

```tsx
useEffect(() => {
  window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
});
```

```tsx
onMount(() => {
  const id = setInterval(tick, 1000);
});
```

## Correct

```tsx
useEffect(() => {
  window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
  onCleanup(() => window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize));
});
```

```tsx
onMount(() => {
  const id = setInterval(tick, 1000);
  return () => clearInterval(id);
});
```

## Options

```json
[
  {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "checkTimeouts": {
        "type": "boolean"
      },
      "checkAnimationFrames": {
        "type": "boolean"
      }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
]
```

Defaults: `[{}]`

## Suggestions

The suggestion inserts `onCleanup(...)` after the statement that starts the work (importing `onCleanup` from `@shadow-js/core` when needed): `removeEventListener` with the listener's arguments, `clearInterval` / `clearTimeout` / `cancelAnimationFrame` of the stored id, `.close()` of a stored resource, or the stored subscription. It is withheld when the statement is not in a block, when the work sits in a nested callback or a `return` statement, when a listener has no receiver or its handler is not a name or member, when the timer, resource or subscription is not the initializer of a variable declarator, or when `onCleanup` is already bound to something else.

## Disabling

Disable one line with `// eslint-disable-next-line shadow/effect-cleanup-registered`, a block with `/* eslint-disable shadow/effect-cleanup-registered */` and `/* eslint-enable shadow/effect-cleanup-registered */`, or a whole file with the block form at its top. Disable it when the work is released by code the rule cannot see (a helper that registers the cleanup elsewhere), or when it must outlive the owner on purpose.

## Notes

- Listeners registered with `{ once: true }` or `{ signal }` release themselves and are not reported.
- A cleanup that is not written inline (`return stop;`, `onCleanup(stop)`) is trusted.
- Options: `checkTimeouts` (default false) also checks `setTimeout`; `checkAnimationFrames` (default false) checks `requestAnimationFrame`.

## Messages

- `missingCleanup`: `{{what}}` inside `{{api}}` is never released. Register `onCleanup(...)` or return a cleanup function.
- `addCleanup`: Register a cleanup with `onCleanup`.
